verdict.rationale: Gemini is driven by natural language. Users converse by voice or text through Gemini Live and "Hey Google", and with permission Gemini can take actions in connected apps, such as creating Calendar events or editing content, to complete a request. Users can also schedule recurring actions. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration that natural-language commands reliably carry out in-app actions (community evidence covers answer quality, not command execution).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: With your permission, Gemini can also help you take actions, like editing and managing your content in other apps.
Summarize emails from Gmail, create events in Google Calendar or third-party apps, or search for content across a variety of productivity apps.
With Gemini Live, you can have a natural, free-flowing conversation with Gemini.
Talk to Gemini without typing, and Gemini will respond back verbally.
On Android, say “Hey Google” to ask Gemini for help with what’s on your screen
